properties.text: For all integers a and b, add(a, b) returns a + b.
For all strings a and b, add(a, b) returns the concatenation of a and b.
If b is 0, quotient(a, b) raises ZeroDivisionError.
For integers a and b with b nonzero, quotient(a, b) returns the floor of a divided by b.
If b is 0, fraction(a, b) raises ZeroDivisionError.
For integers a and b with b nonzero, fraction(a, b) returns a float equal to the correctly rounded quotient a / b.
